job.job_description: Role Summar We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer GenAI / Agentic AI to design, build, and deploy intelligent, autonomous AI systems. The role involves working on Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and Agentic AI frameworks to solve real-world enterprise problems. Key Responsibilities • Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using LLMs • Build and optimize RAG pipelines with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.) • Develop multi-agent systems using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI • Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, tools, and workflows • Fine-tune and prompt-engineer LLMs for domain-specific use cases • Implement evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for GenAI systems • Collaborate with product, data, and cloud teams for scalable deployment • Ensure performance, cost optimization, security, and compliance Mandatory Skills • Python (Strong proficiency) • AI/ML fundamentals NLP, Deep Learning, Transformers • Generative AI & LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, LLaMA, etc.) • Agentic AI frameworks – LangChain / LangGraph / AutoGen / CrewAI • RAG architecture and vector databases • Prompt engineering & LLM orchestration • REST APIs, microservices integration Good to Have • Fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, PEFT) • Experience with MLOps / LLMOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, monitoring tools) • Cloud platforms: AWS / Azure / GCP • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes • Experience in enterprise use cases (BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom) Qualifications • B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field • 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML with recent focus on GenAI / Agentic AI Why Join Us • Work on cutting-edge Agentic AI & GenAI platforms • Opportunity to build autonomous, production-grade AI systems • High-impact enterprise projects • Collaborative and innovation-driven environment
